evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform
Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here);
Admission requires a high school certificate;

notes: Tuition is stated in USD on the programme page; no EUR or HUF amount for this programme appears. The B2 English requirement: the programme page says 'Please note, that you are not strictly required to have a language exam certificate', but a separate application page requires 'a standardized, at least upper-intermediate (B2) level language certificate, obtained at a proctored exam', so certificateRequired is left null. The 15th June deadline is a general self-financed deadline without a year and is not explicitly labelled for non-EU/international applicants on that page.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
